title: 营销想跟上热点，怎样做得相关又可信？
topic: 从消费者真实行为出发，用品牌可信度和测试支撑营销创意

source.title: Unilever's marketing transformation explained
source.type: 联合利华官方营销转型与品牌增长案例
source.context: Unilever 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
source.author: Leandro Barreto
paragraphs: In this new landscape, growth belongs to the brands that stay relevant. Those that understand what people care about, how culture is evolving and where they can add value rather than noise.

And for that, you need both creativity and infrastructure. Think of it as poetry and plumbing. Poetry is the cultural intuition and creative courage that sparks ideas people care about. Plumbing is the operating backbone – the systems, data and AI capabilities – that allows you to optimise and scale those ideas quickly.

Second, we don’t just ‘show up’ in culture, we participate with intention. That starts with clarity on what the brand stands for, what makes it distinctive and where it has the credibility to contribute – and equally, where it doesn’t. That clarity drives depth. We go beyond surface level trends by spending time in our communities: listening, learning and uncovering the human nuances others overlook. It’s in those lived insights that the most meaningful opportunities for connection – and growth – are found.

The #VaselineVerified campaign tapped into millions of consumer-generated hacks shared across social channels and then validated them – or not – through lab testing by Unilever scientists. By embracing influencers as co-creators, the campaign delivered a 43% uplift in sales. It also earned recognition at the Cannes Lions Festival, including the prestigious Titanium Lion award. Relevance wasn’t an add‑on; it was the entire idea.
translations: 在新的营销环境中，增长属于那些始终与人们关心的事保持关联的品牌。它们了解人们在意什么、文化如何变化，也知道品牌能带来什么价值，而不是制造更多噪音。
为此，既需要创意，也需要基础设施。可以把它想成“诗与管道”：诗是文化直觉和创意勇气，能激发人们关心的点子；管道是运营底座——系统、数据和 AI 能力——帮助团队快速优化并扩大这些创意。
品牌不能只是在文化话题中“露面”，还要有目的地参与。首先要清楚品牌代表什么、有什么独特之处、在哪些领域有可信度且适合发声，也要知道哪些领域不适合介入。这种清晰度能带来更深入的参与。品牌需要花时间倾听和了解社群，发现别人容易忽略的人情细节；真正有意义的连接和增长机会往往来自这些真实洞察。
#VaselineVerified 活动从社交平台上数百万条消费者分享的使用技巧中寻找灵感，再由联合利华科学家通过实验室测试验证这些方法是否有效。活动邀请影响者共同创作，带动销售额提升 43%，并获得戛纳国际创意节多个奖项，包括著名的 Titanium Lion。相关性不是额外添加的元素，而是整个创意的核心。
fullTextParagraphs: Fresh from his panel discussion at SXSW, Chief Marketing Officer Leandro Barreto shares his vision for the next era of Unilever’s marketing transformation: building desire, trust and relevance in a shifting landscape shaped by platforms and creators.
We’re entering a new era of marketing.
Digital acceleration and the democratisation of technology have sparked a profound shift in how people connect, opening up entirely new ways for brands to engage with them.
The volume of content is growing exponentially, offering limitless opportunities for discovery.
Attention is becoming scarcer, rewarding brands that show up with relevance and immediacy.
And people are seeking trusted voices, giving brands the chance to earn credibility through authentic, culturally grounded participation.
This is a completely new operating context. And yet, here’s the paradox. The mechanics of engagement may have changed dramatically, but the fundamentals of marketing have not.
Marketing has always been about mattering to people – their passions, rituals, identities – and building brands that connect deeply with them.
In this new landscape, growth belongs to the brands that stay relevant. Those that understand what people care about, how culture is evolving and where they can add value rather than noise.
Put simply – relevance is the engine of growth.
Fragmented attention and consumer discernment aren’t barriers – they’re opportunities. An invitation to show up with greater meaning in people’s lives.

And for that, you need both creativity and infrastructure. Think of it as poetry and plumbing. Poetry is the cultural intuition and creative courage that sparks ideas people care about. Plumbing is the operating backbone – the systems, data and AI capabilities – that allows you to optimise and scale those ideas quickly.

Today, that plumbing is more powerful than ever. It’s AI models that predict trends before they happen, content engines that generate, personalise and adapt thousands of assets in real time and measurement systems that link cultural participation directly to business growth.
Poetry creates emotional resonance and desire. Plumbing makes it repeatable and exponentially more effective; that’s how we create Desire at Scale.
Our approach is rooted in two key principles.

First, we go where consumers are. That means growing our brands by embedding them authentically in the spaces where trust, influence and real conversations happen. Today, culture is an ecosystem: from hyper‑local micro‑influencers to mass‑participation moments that capture global attention.

These are not opposite ends of a spectrum. Micro‑moments rooted in niche communities and mass moments like the FIFA World Cup fuel and strengthen each other. Creators, fans, commentators and communities pick up what happens on the global stage, reinterpret it and carry it into their own spaces. A single moment becomes a movement because the whole ecosystem amplifies it.

Second, we don’t just ‘show up’ in culture, we participate with intention. That starts with clarity on what the brand stands for, what makes it distinctive and where it has the credibility to contribute – and equally, where it doesn’t. That clarity drives depth. We go beyond surface level trends by spending time in our communities: listening, learning and uncovering the human nuances others overlook. It’s in those lived insights that the most meaningful opportunities for connection – and growth – are found.

The #VaselineVerified campaign tapped into millions of consumer-generated hacks shared across social channels and then validated them – or not – through lab testing by Unilever scientists. By embracing influencers as co-creators, the campaign delivered a 43% uplift in sales. It also earned recognition at the Cannes Lions Festival, including the prestigious Titanium Lion award. Relevance wasn’t an add‑on; it was the entire idea.

Working with Arsenal’s Women’s team, Dirt Is Good discovered that period stains left during play were a source of anxiety. Instead of quietly solving the problem of removing them, Dirt Is Good entered the conversation differently, reframing those stains as part of the game, in a campaign co-created with Arsenal Women players and a group of girls aged 13–18. That’s not sponsorship; that’s cultural participation. And that participation keeps paying off, ensuring that Dirt Is Good remains the No.1 fabric detergent globally.

Then there’s Dove. The core belief that women deserve a more honest, inclusive definition of beauty hasn’t changed in over 20 years. The way we express it has. Dove has continually evolved how it participates in culture. This momentum is fuelled by fresh, culturally resonant work – from Dove x Crumbl, which brought new shoppers into the brand, to a campaign built on Reddit reviews. That evolution drives real business impact. In 2025, Dove delivered strong growth in both our Beauty & Wellbeing and Personal Care business groups.

In today’s world, consumer journeys are fluid, dynamic and shaped by the people, platforms and moments that matter to them. The brands that thrive are the ones that bring community, culture and commerce into a single, connected ecosystem.
The magic happens when these become indistinguishable. When relevance sparks engagement and engagement fuels commercial impact.
The brands that win – that grow – won’t be the loudest: they’ll be the most relevant.

What is Desire at Scale? Desire at Scale is Unilever’s new growth engine. It enables us to design brands people don’t just need but also want. Brands that spark pleasure, trust and belonging – and convert that feeling into consistent growth. It’s a brand building and marketing model anchored in our SASSY approach, which uses superior science, aesthetics and sensorials to power young-spirited brands that people want to talk about.

How do brands build relevance in a fragmented media landscape? Brands build relevance by earning the right to matter inside communities - combining cultural intuition with data-driven content systems. The key is maintaining consistency of meaning across every channel and being very clear about which conversations are genuinely yours to join.

What is creator-led marketing? Creator-led marketing uses content creators to produce authentic, platform-native content that reaches audiences where they already spend time. At Unilever, it operates alongside traditional advertising - not instead of it - as one component of a holistic brand building strategy designed to earn attention, credibility and trust.

Sunsilk, the most-chosen hair brand globally, is transforming to win with Gen Z. Here’s how its market-making new launch – a science-backed, mood-boosting hair mist – is just the start of a mission to bring play back to hair care.

For 93% of Gen Z, cooking is the ultimate green flag on a dating profile. Discover how Knorr used this insight in a social-first influencer campaign that embedded the brand authentically in Gen Z dating culture to drive growth.
Esi Eggleston Bracey, Unilever’s Chief Growth and Marketing Officer, shares how our Desire at Scale marketing strategy is helping brands connect with people authentically and at speed to drive sales.

notes.phrase: growth belongs to the brands that stay relevant
notes.meaning: 增长机会更偏向能与消费者保持相关性的品牌。
notes.explain: stay relevant 指持续回应消费者在意的事，而不是追逐所有热点。
notes.example: Brands grow when they stay relevant to customers.

notes.phrase: you need both creativity and infrastructure
notes.meaning: 营销既需要创意，也需要支持创意落地的系统和数据能力。
notes.explain: infrastructure 在这里指系统、数据和 AI 能力，帮助创意规模化。
notes.example: We need both a strong idea and the data to scale it.

notes.phrase: where it has the credibility to contribute – and equally, where it doesn’t
notes.meaning: 品牌要知道自己在哪些话题上有可信度，也要知道哪些不适合介入。
notes.explain: credibility 指品牌有可信的参与理由；原文也强调判断不该介入的领域。
notes.example: The brand should participate where it has credibility.

notes.phrase: the campaign delivered a 43% uplift in sales
notes.meaning: 这项活动使销售额提升了 43%。
notes.explain: 原文将 43% sales uplift 归于 Vaseline Verified 活动；表达时保留“案例报告”的归因边界。
notes.example: The campaign delivered a 12% uplift in sales.

scenario.title: 品牌营销：把消费者分享转成可信内容
english: Customers are sharing creative ways to use your skin-care product across social media.
The brand wants to join the conversation, but some tips may be unsafe or unrelated to what the brand can credibly support.
Propose a way to review the tips with experts, involve creators, and measure whether the campaign drives meaningful business results.
chinese: 消费者正在社交媒体上分享护肤品的创意用法。
品牌希望参与讨论，但部分技巧可能不安全，或与品牌有可信度的领域无关。
请提出专家审核内容、邀请创作者参与，并衡量活动是否带来实际业务结果的做法。

firstAttempt.prompt: 消费者在社交媒体分享某类产品的使用技巧。请用英语提出如何筛选可信内容、邀请消费者参与，并用业务指标评估活动。
firstAttempt.sample: Customers are already sharing product-use tips, so a campaign built around selected ideas can help the brand stay relevant to consumers. Our product experts should validate each tip through testing before we feature it, and selected creators can show how to use it. We should track qualified engagement, product-page visits, and sales uplift against a comparable period.
firstAttempt.rationale: 从消费者真实内容出发，先确认品牌有可信参与依据，再用专家验证和业务指标避免只追求互动量。

words.meaning: 保持相关；持续回应需求
words.example: The brand needs to stay relevant to younger consumers.
words.translation: 这个品牌需要持续回应年轻消费者的关注点。
words.note: 强调与消费者当下在意的事情保持联系。

words.example: We have credibility to contribute to conversations about skin safety.
words.translation: 我们有可信度参与有关皮肤安全的讨论。
words.note: 品牌参与某个话题前，需要有相关经验或专业依据。

words.example: The campaign delivered an uplift in sales during the launch period.
words.translation: 这项活动在上市期间带来了销售额提升。
words.note: uplift 指某项活动或变化带来的增长。

taskPhrases.meaning: 持续回应消费者的关注点
taskPhrases.example: A campaign built around customer tips can help the brand stay relevant to consumers.
taskPhrases.translation: 围绕顾客技巧设计的活动，能帮助品牌持续回应消费者关注。

taskPhrases.meaning: 通过测试验证一条技巧
taskPhrases.example: Our product experts should validate each tip through testing.
taskPhrases.translation: 产品专家应通过测试验证每条技巧。

taskPhrases.word: track sales uplift against a comparable period
taskPhrases.meaning: 对比相似时段衡量销售增幅
taskPhrases.collocation: track sales uplift against + comparable period
taskPhrases.example: We should track sales uplift against a comparable period.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们应与相似时段对比，衡量销售增幅。

structure.original: By embracing influencers as co-creators, the campaign delivered a 43% uplift in sales.
analysis: By + 动名词说明活动采用的做法。
embracing influencers as co-creators 把影响者定位为共同创作者。
主句直接报告业务结果 delivered a 43% uplift in sales。
structure.transfer: By inviting store employees as co-creators, the launch campaign increased qualified product-page visits.

rewrite.bad: We should join the trend because everyone is talking about it.
rewrite.good: Customers are already sharing product-use tips, so we can build a campaign around selected ideas to stay relevant to consumers. Our product experts should validate each tip through testing before we feature it, and selected creators can show how to use it. We should track qualified engagement and sales uplift against a comparable period.
rewrite.translation: 消费者已经在分享产品使用技巧，因此我们可以围绕其中合适的内容设计活动，持续回应消费者关注。产品专家应先通过测试验证每条技巧，再决定是否展示；选定的创作者可以演示用法。我们应跟踪有效互动，并与相似时段对比销售增幅。
rewrite.pattern: Customers are already [behavior]. We can stay relevant to consumers by [campaign]. Validate [content] through testing, then track [engagement] and sales uplift against [baseline].

cloze.prompt: The campaign helped the brand stay ______ to consumers.
cloze.why: stay relevant 表示与消费者关注点保持联系。

cloze.prompt: Our experts should ______ the product-use tips.
cloze.why: validate 表示通过证据或测试确认真实性。

cloze.prompt: The campaign delivered an ______ in sales.
cloze.why: an uplift in sales 表示销售额提升。

dictation.label: 听写 1
dictation.text: Those that understand what people care about, how culture is evolving and where they can add value rather than noise.
dictation.why: 听清 where 引导的品牌贡献方向。

apply.prompt: 我们的专家通过测试验证了这些产品使用技巧。
apply.sample: Our experts validated the product-use tips through testing.

dictation.label: 听写 2
dictation.text: By embracing influencers as co-creators, the campaign delivered a 43% uplift in sales.
dictation.why: 留意 By + 动名词说明做法，主句报告结果。

apply.prompt: 这项活动带来了销售额提升。
apply.sample: The campaign delivered an uplift in sales.

translationPractice.prompt: 围绕顾客技巧设计的活动，能帮助品牌持续回应消费者关注。
translationPractice.answer: A campaign built around customer tips can help the brand stay relevant to consumers.
translationPractice.why: 用 stay relevant to + 人群说明相关对象。

translationPractice.prompt: 产品专家应通过测试验证每条技巧。
translationPractice.answer: Our product experts should validate each tip through testing.
translationPractice.why: 用 validate 说明经过证据核验。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们应与相似时段对比，衡量销售增幅。
translationPractice.answer: We should track sales uplift against a comparable period.
translationPractice.why: 用 uplift 报告业务增长结果。

choice.prompt: 消费者分享了一种护肤技巧，品牌希望据此做营销。哪种做法既相关又可信？
options: Repeat the most viral tip without checking whether it is safe.
Select tips connected to the product, validate them with experts, invite creators to explain the results, and track sales as well as engagement.
Post a generic message about innovation and measure likes only.
choice.why: 第二条确认了品牌参与的依据、内容安全性和业务效果，不只看热度。

output.prompt: 顾客分享了一种清洁产品的新用法。请用英文给品牌团队建议如何验证、如何邀请顾客参与，以及活动上线后看什么指标。
output.sample: Customers are already sharing a new way to use the cleaner, so we should test whether it is safe and genuinely useful before featuring it. Our product team can validate the method, and selected customers can help demonstrate it. We should track qualified engagement, repeat purchase, and sales lift against a comparable period.
check: 说明品牌为什么参与这个话题
提出验证内容真实性或安全性的办法
同时衡量参与度和业务结果

blockers: 人工听审音频并核对台词、停顿和语速
真实账号学习进度与生产页面验收
